title: Unit 17 Consolidation: nationalism and the State
goal: Review the stronger states of 1900-1930, with the grammar of Unit 17.

items: I can say what the new states created, with the passive with *se*.
I can admit a contrast and go on, with *a pesar de* and *pese a*.
I can link two changes that grow together, with *a medida que* and *cuanto más ..., más ...*.
I can describe how people lived and travelled, with impersonal *se*.
I can say how the State changed, with verbs of change.
